nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a nonempty finite type carrying a σ-algebra. For every measurable set $s \subseteq \alpha$, the probability measure associated to the uniform distribution on $\alpha$ gives $s$ the measure $|s| / |\alpha|$, computed in the extended nonnegative reals.
nodes.title: Probability of an event under the uniform distribution

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a nonempty finite type. For every subset $s \subseteq \alpha$, the outer measure associated to the uniform distribution on $\alpha$ assigns to $s$ the value $|s| / |\alpha|$, computed in the extended nonnegative reals.
nodes.title: Outer measure of an event under the uniform distribution

nodes.summary: For a nonempty finite type $\alpha$, the uniform distribution on the finite set of all elements of $\alpha$ equals the uniform distribution on $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Uniform distribution on the whole finite type

nodes.summary: For a nonempty finite subset $s$ of a type $\alpha$, the uniform distribution on $s$ is the probability mass function on $\alpha$ that gives mass $1/|s|$ to each element of $s$ and mass $0$ to every other element of $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Uniform distribution on a finite set

nodes.summary: For a nonempty finite type $\alpha$, the uniform distribution on $\alpha$ is the probability mass function on $\alpha$ that gives mass $1/|\alpha|$ to every element of $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Uniform distribution on a finite type

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
